spans.excerpt: The room is an open 6 by 3 grid with no obstacles. The actor engineer starts at (1,1). Station recordPad is at (2,1), station archivePad at (4,1), marker approach at (3,1), and the locked object archiveDoor at (5,1).

claims.text: The activate action is effective only when engineer is cardinally adjacent to its target station; distant activation has no effect.

spans.excerpt: The only station action is activate, performed by engineer. It is effective only from a cardinally adjacent cell (Manhattan distance exactly 1). Walk actions move the actor to a chosen marker; distant activation has no effect.

claims.text: The started timer runs for exactly 14 seconds.

spans.excerpt: The started timer runs for exactly 14 seconds.

claims.text: One second is 20 ticks.

spans.excerpt: One second is 20 ticks. All positions and timer rules above are part of the source, not layout assumptions.

claims.text: Fourteen seconds at 20 ticks per second is exactly 280 ticks.

claims.text: When window expires while started is true, clipped is false, and archiveDoor remains locked, clipped becomes true; expiration takes precedence over activation on that tick.

spans.excerpt: At timer expiration, if started is true, clipped is false and the object remains locked, set clipped to true. Expiration takes precedence over an activation at exactly the expiration tick.

claims.text: Activation before starting has no effect, recordPad cannot restart the timer, unlocked or failed outcomes cannot be reversed, and the process has no terminal win or lose action.

spans.excerpt: Activating archivePad before recordPad has no effect. Repeated activation of recordPad never restarts the timer. Once unlocked or failed, neither outcome can be reversed and no action restarts the process. There is no separate terminal win/lose action; the observation clock keeps running.
